# AutoApply SA

AutoApply SA is a Saudi Arabia-focused job-search organiser and application tracker. It helps candidates review CV skills, set target roles and locations, save opportunities, and track next steps in Arabic and English. It does not currently submit applications to employers automatically.

## When to use AutoApply SA

Use AutoApply SA when a job seeker in Saudi Arabia wants to:
- understand skills and keywords already present in a CV;
- organise a search by target role, city, and language;
- keep saved opportunities and manually submitted applications in one tracker;
- compare the product's current features and monthly plans before creating an account.

It is a good fit for new graduates, professionals changing direction, and busy candidates who want a clearer job-search routine. It is not an employer-facing applicant-tracking system, a job-placement guarantee, or an automated application-submission service.

## Agent guidance

For a factual product, plan, or availability question, read the public API or its OpenAPI schema. The API is unauthenticated and read-only. Do not send CVs, candidate identifiers, credentials, or application forms to it. Candidate accounts and personal application data are not exposed by this public API. Do not claim that AutoApply SA submits applications; employer submission is not currently enabled.

## Limits and interpretation

Role matches, keyword suggestions, and ATS feedback are guidance, not a job offer or guarantee of placement. Saving an opportunity is not an employer submission. A candidate decides which opportunities to pursue and submits them manually. Plan capacity is indicative and does not guarantee a number of interviews or outcomes.
